Class NaturalDisasterHelper

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.events.NaturalDisasterHelper
public final class NaturalDisasterHelper extends Object

NaturalDisasterHelper

Evaluates stochastic and triggered natural disasters (volcanism along tectonic faults, droughts, famines, plagues, earthquakes, tsunamis, and regional ecological stress). All evaluations use strictly stateless deterministic PRNG anchored to scenario seed, year, and tick.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
